svg.title: Bootstrap order
svg.desc: Follow each row from left to right, then continue below.

g.text: Follow each row from left to right, then continue below.
Steps 4 to 6: verify the underlay and install k0s
Stop if a preflight check fails. Repair the underlay before applying k0s.
Steps 7 to 9: recovery access and Pod networking
Workers stay NotReady until Cilium is installed: custom CNI, no kube-proxy.
Step 10: verify the core, then add optional services
Keep the direct recovery kubeconfig. Before sharing the cluster, replace wildcard
grants with scoped access and give each user an appropriate Kubernetes role.
